title: Interpretable Text Embeddings Based on Hierarchical Questions
abstract: arXiv:2611.06402v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: QA-based text embeddings represent texts as vectors consisting of 1/0 answers to yes/no questions. Although these embeddings provide detailed information for interpretation and achieve high task performance, they often require humans to examine a large number of questions. Furthermore, the relationship between the number of questions and the appropriate level of question granularity has not been sufficiently studied. To address these challenges, we propose a method for constructing hierarchical questions for text embeddings. As the hierarchy deepens, questions become more specific and their number increases. During interpretation, we reduce the number of questions that humans need to examine by replacing questions at deeper levels with aligned questions at shallower levels. The question hierarchy is constructed through recursive clustering, contrastive prompting, and question alignment. Experimental results on general-purpose tasks show

translated_title: 基于层次化问题的可解释文本嵌入
translated_abstract: 基于问答的文本嵌入将文本表示为由是/否问题的1/0答案组成的向量。尽管这类嵌入能够为解释提供详细信息并取得较高的任务性能，但它们通常需要人工检查大量问题。此外，问题数量与问题粒度适当级别之间的关系尚未得到充分研究。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种为文本嵌入构建层次化问题的方法。随着层次的加深，问题变得更加具体，数量也随之增加。在解释过程中，我们通过用较浅层次的对齐问题替换较深层次的问题，减少了人工需要检查的问题数量。该问题层次结构通过递归聚类、对比提示和问题对齐来构建。在通用任务上的实验结果表明（摘要内容在此截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于层次化问题的可解释文本嵌入方法，通过递归聚类、对比提示和问题对齐构建问题层次结构，在保持较高任务性能的同时，显著减少了人工解释时需要检查的问题数量。
